    2026-11-09 Classical mechanics

    Canonical transformations

    In this article we derive the Hamilton's equations both from the Lagrangian formulation, as well as directly from a variational principle. This enables us to develop the language of canonical transformations, which will prove themselves to be a powerful tool in future posts.
    2026-08-19 Special relativity

    Derivation of the Lorentz transformation

    We introduce Einstein's two postulates of special relativity. From them we derive the invariance of the spacetime interval, from which Lorentz transformation follows. A geometrical interpretation for the transformation is also given.
    2026-07-25 Quantum mechanics

    Heisenberg uncertainty relation

    In this article we introduce the notion of a measurement in QM. We introduce the definition of the dispersion of an observable. After proving the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality in bra-ket notation, we derive an uncertainty relation, which applied to the position and momentum operator is known as Heisenberg uncertainty relation.
